cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.

mechanism: A limits a job-offer preference request to one name and promises A decision afterward, keeping B cooperative while seeking an uncolored preference.
confusable: Unlike asking for advice after revealing a preference, A wants B desired outcome before A own choice enters.
comparison: A city job choice and bounded answer bargain differ from election names written separately.
seedUse: D208-b job offers and happiness deflection; S02-b narrows the answer and offers immediate reciprocal disclosure.
